scope: A fair 2x2 FFT ablation for the same factorized execution shape. The core axis selects the native register-tile codelet or the imported cuFFTDx block codelet. The dataflow axis selects serial factor execution or dependency-sliced factor overlap. Both axes keep the workload, logical partition, factor partition, shared layout, EPT, columns, CTA tile count, and prefetch policy fixed within each case.

non_hybrid_definition.label: serial-factor
non_hybrid_definition.meaning: The same two dependency-closed factor slices and fixed factor groups execute serially with no inter-slice dependency overlap. This is the traditional fixed-group control, not a claim that the factor decomposition disappears.

hybrid_definition.label: sliced-hybrid
hybrid_definition.meaning: The same factorized subgraphs execute two dependency-closed slices with the factor pipeline enabled. The arithmetic core and factor shape remain unchanged.
